camel_example: aliyun iot BatchUpdateDeviceNickname --region cn-hangzhou --DeviceNicknameInfo.1.IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --DeviceNicknameInfo.1.DeviceName light --DeviceNicknameInfo.1.ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceNicknameInfo.1.Nickname AliyunDataCenter
description_en: Batch updates the nicknames of devices
description_zh: 调用该接口批量修改设备备注名称
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-update-device-nickname --device-nickname-info IotId=Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 ProductKey=a1BwAGV0000 DeviceName=light Nickname=AliyunDataCenter --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchUpdateDeviceNickname

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

fields.help_en:
The device name of the device whose nickname you want to update.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
fields.help_zh:
要修改备注名称的设备名称。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
fields.name: device_name

fields.help_en:
The ID of the device whose nickname you want to update.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey and DeviceName. The IotId parameter serves as the unique identifier of the device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
fields.help_zh:
要修改备注名称的设备ID。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
fields.name: iot_id

fields.help_en:
The new nickname of the device. The nickname must be 4 to 32 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the existing nickname of the device is deleted
fields.help_zh:
新的设备备注名称。备注名称长度为4~32个字符，可包含中文汉字、英文字母、数字和下划线（_）。一个中文汉字算2个字符。

若不传入该参数，则删除该设备原有的备注名称
fields.name: nickname

fields.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device whose nickname you want to update belongs.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
fields.help_zh:
要修改备注名称的设备所隶属的产品ProductKey。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
fields.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The list of devices whose nicknames you want to update
parameters.help_zh: 要修改备注名称的设备列表
parameters.name: device_nickname_info
